description: List the user's configured groups. ExpenseBot stores clients, projects, project codes, properties, and trips as tags (for example 'Client: Acme', 'Vegas Trip', or 'Property: 123 Main'). Use this when the user asks 'what groups/projects/clients do I have?' and before filtering, grouping, or reporting when the intended existing name is unclear.
name: list_tags
